channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Glen Taylor | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Glen Taylor from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Adam Silver on Glen Taylor
item.description:
“It’s within our rules, from that standpoint, and it’s what Glen Taylor wanted and it’s what they were willing to agree to at the time. But I think once the dust clears on this deal, it may cause us to reassess what sort of transactions we should allow.”

Adam Silver on Glen Taylor, Apr 12, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Glen Taylor, Gersson Rosas
item.description:
Chauncey Billups:

“I liked the Minnesota situation. They have some good people. I love (owner Glen Taylor) so I was attracted to the situation. Interviewed well, but obviously they went with Gersson Rosas, who was a very good candidate and I’m sure will do a terrific job. But even with that situation, they reached out to me.”

Chauncey Billups on Glen Taylor, Gersson Rosas, Aug 3, 2019. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Glen Taylor, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Kevin Garnett on Jimmy Butler:

“He’s dealing with [Timberwolves owner Glen Taylor], who doesn’t know shit about basketball.”

Kevin Garnett on Glen Taylor, Jimmy Butler, Oct 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Glen Taylor, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Towns on signing the contract and his relationship with Butler:

“That situation never had anything to do with Jimmy. It was me and Glen Taylor and it got handled.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Glen Taylor, Jimmy Butler, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Tom Thibodeau, Glen Taylor
item.description:
Wiggins said in a statement released by the team.

“I love it here. The fans and organization have supported me from my first day here in Minnesota. I want to thank Glen Taylor, Tom Thibodeau, the entire coaching staff and my teammates for believing in me. We've had some good times over the last three seasons, but the best is yet to come. I look forward to doing right by them and bringing this team to the postseason.”

Andrew Wiggins on Tom Thibodeau, Glen Taylor, Oct 11, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Glen Taylor
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Wiggins on meeting w/Taylor:

“Just making sure we’re both committed toward this. We both love the Timberwolves.”

Andrew Wiggins on Glen Taylor, Oct 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @APkrawczynski.

item.title: Kevin Martin on Rick Adelman, Glen Taylor
item.description:
Ray Richardson:Kevin Martin on his offseason talk with Glen Taylor:

“We both felt that last year was a disrespect to (former coach) Rick Adelman.”

Kevin Martin on Rick Adelman, Glen Taylor, Sep 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @twolvesnow.

item.title: Derek Fisher on David Stern, Glen Taylor, Adam Silver
item.description:
“I think Peter and Glen Taylor, Mr. Stern, Adam Silver are articulating certain things in the room, expressing their desire to get a deal done,”

Derek Fisher on David Stern, Glen Taylor, Adam Silver, Aug 2, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.
